resilienceSpread: Owner ruling, October 9, 2026: a personal resilience line for each person replaces the same-for-everyone threshold of Ruling 29. Spread: under the SSA 2023 period life table's proportional hazards, the integrated hazard reached at death is a unit exponential (the standard survival-analysis result, e.g. Cox and Oakes, Analysis of Survival Data, 1984, chapter 1); each person's line is that spread read at their stable generation key.

source.citation: Ruling 29/38/39 ordinary all-cause mortality: SSA 2023 period life table hazard times recorded chronic-condition weights (data/research/health/chronic-condition-pack-2026.json) against one fixed strain threshold; the old engine's mortality.ts, condition-pack.ts, death-causes.ts.
source.estimatedFrom: Pure helpers of the existing no-dice mortality rule, applied to core2 residents from the world's opening day; no seeded roll decides a death date.

gaps: Conditions that begin during life, coverage records and the below-poverty-line onset cause are not ported; only opening conditions and the serious-illness onset and death they lead to run.
Injury, sudden illness and births have no core2 producer yet.
Household income for the opening condition ranking uses recorded job pay; households without recorded pay sort as unknown, as in the old rule.

youthCannabis.about: Each full person aged 12 to 17 carries a past-month cannabis use record, decided once a month on the web's refresh day by the adult drug-use condition's rule: the national share moved on the log-odds scale by their conscientiousness, the place's count from the share, and the outcome web's factor for health.youth-cannabis-use on each teen's share (cannabis-sales-to-youth-use).
